sources.title: Lula says Paraguay chose to invade Brazil; Paraguayan Congress accuses him of distorting history
sources.subject: Brazil-Paraguay diplomatic tensions, War of the Triple Alliance remarks
sources.summary: Lula, defending increased Brazilian defense spending, said Paraguay 'one day decided to invade Brazil' (invoking the 1864-1870 War of the Triple Alliance) and later did the same to Argentina and Uruguay; both chambers of Paraguay's Congress formally repudiated the remarks.

sources.title: Two months from the vote, Lula turns diplomatic crises into a sovereignty message
sources.subject: Brazil-Paraguay diplomatic tensions, Brazilian election context
sources.summary: Frames the Triple Alliance remark as one of several diplomatic fronts Lula has opened roughly two months ahead of Brazil's October 4, 2026 presidential election, arguing he is using sovereignty messaging for domestic political benefit; notes the episode landing alongside separate Itaipu dam renegotiation talks.

sources.title: Lula Paraguay Remark Sparks Diplomatic Row Over 1864 War
sources.subject: Brazil-Paraguay diplomatic tensions, War of the Triple Alliance remarks
sources.summary: Reports Paraguay summoning Brazilian Ambassador José Antonio Marcondes de Carvalho and delivering a formal protest note over Lula's remarks; historians dispute Lula's framing, noting the war escalated after Brazil's own 1864 military intervention in Uruguay, then allied with Paraguay.

sources.title: Gobierno rechaza declaraciones del presidente del Brasil sobre la Guerra de la Triple Alianza
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores de la República del Paraguay
sources.subject: Brazil-Paraguay diplomatic tensions, official Paraguayan government response
sources.summary: Official statement from Paraguay's Foreign Ministry rejecting Lula's statements on the War of the Triple Alliance; includes note delivered to Brazil's ambassador and renewed demand for return of historical archives/war trophies.

sources.title: Historiadora paraguaya responde a Lula tras polémicas declaraciones sobre la Triple Alianza
sources.subject: Brazil-Paraguay diplomatic tensions, historical context/rebuttal
sources.summary: A Paraguayan historian rebuts Lula's characterization of the War of the Triple Alliance's origins, providing historical context on the conflict's actual causes (territorial disputes, river-navigation control, and Brazil's 1864 intervention in Uruguay).

sources.title: Aumenta la tensión en la región: Paraguay convocó al embajador de Brasil para rechazar palabras de Lula sobre la guerra que enfrentó a ambos países
sources.subject: Brazil-Paraguay diplomatic tensions, regional coverage
sources.summary: Regional (Colombian) coverage of Paraguay summoning Brazil's ambassador over Lula's War of the Triple Alliance remarks, situating the episode within broader Paraguay-Brazil relations.
